_schema.description: Per-module dtype overrides keyed by model variant and mesh shape. Modules without an override use the model-wide default dtype (bfloat16). The model variant key is the basename of the model path; mesh shape is the worker grid (rows x cols, e.g. 1x2 / 1x8). Within a model, lookup tries the exact mesh-shape key first, then 'default'. Module keys: shared_mlp, attention, experts, router, lm_head, embedding. Allowed dtype values: bf16, bfp8, fp32.

_note_gemma-4-12B-it: REMOVED 2026-09-16. The distributor ships pure bf16 (config dtype=bfloat16; all 677 safetensors tensors BF16), so bfp8 here was a tt-metal-side precision change, not the model default. Measured cost at 1x1 on the full-model-vs-HF PCC with a well-formed (BOS-prefixed) prompt: bf16 0.9942 vs bfp8 0.9546 (last-token 0.9931 vs 0.9384). bf16 fits at 1x1 on a 31.88 GiB p150a and runs spec decode end-to-end. This entry looks inherited from the 31B row, whose comment in precision.py:12 says such entries exist for DRAM pressure -- a constraint not re-checked for 12B. If a smaller-DRAM system needs bfp8, add a MESH-SCOPED entry rather than a blanket default.
